notes.title: New version is live: v0.10.0
notes.notes: [p]Hi, everyone! Changes in new version are mostly about game mode UI, but there are also changes to weapon behaviour and balance: [/p][list][*][p]Reworked overall UI for Race, Duel and King of the Hill game modes: added UI animations, changed font, replaced old icons;[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked leaderboard UI;[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked player info UI: nickname, status effect, stamina and etc. display is changed;[/p][/*][*][p]Added score display for King of the Hill leaderboard;[/p][/*][*][p]Added stopwatch display for Race UI;[/p][/*][*][p]Changed timer display format to minutes + seconds;[/p][/*][*][p]Changed crosshair to a larger one and more visible;[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon shooting mechanic is reworked: LMB and RMB is now separate weapon abilities that have their own cooldowns;[/p][/*][*][p](Black Hole Generator, LMB) Increased push force by 30%;[/p][/*][*][p](BoxGlove, RMB) Increased AoE push force by 23%;[/p][/*][*][p](Harpoon, LMB) Reduced push force of hit players by 8%;[/p][/*][*][p](Harpoon, RMB) Reduced pull force by 25%;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where sound of booster pick up didn't play;[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: New version is now live 0.9.0
notes.notes: [list][*][p]Added ragdoll stun;[/p][/*][*][p]Added new weapon: Harpoon;[/p][/*][*][p]Added 5 new tattoos;[/p][/*][*][p]Added 3 new coloring variations for BoxGlove;[/p][/*][*][p]Added 3 new coloring variations for Mortar;[/p][/*][*][p]Added 3 new coloring variations for Harpoon;[/p][/*][*][p]Added new player movement animations;[/p][/*][*][p](Rocket Launcher) Increased reload speed by 30%;[/p][/*][*][p](Rocket Launcher \\ Mortar, RMB) Increased AoE force after rocket jump by 20%;[/p][/*][*][p](Rocket Launcher \\ Mortar, RMB) Reduced hit player's air launch height after a rocket jump by 26%;[/p][/*][*][p](Black Hole Generator, LMB) Increased black hole activation distance to 8 meters;[/p][/*][*][p](Box Glove) Reduced dash speed by 5%;[/p][/*][*][p](Booster "Acceleration") Increased acceleration speed by 25%;[/p][/*][*][p](Booster "Acceleration") Reduced acceleration duration to 4 seconds;[/p][/*][*][p]Increased round duration on some maps;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where run VFX can be appear in the air;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where player could move by inertia after respawning;[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41344682/d600909f50d616782caaec0d954ab4f5ea0ae68d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41344682/cf7cc6dfe38868e2074962c20d3643e7b064a49e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41344682/4b532df1fee1bc716200784460a5cc02ed165ba5.png"][/img][/p]
